goal: Is ke baad aap 3-D array ke teeno sizes parh sakein ge, bata sakein ge ke us mein kitne elements hain, usay initialise kar sakein ge, aur teen nested loops se har element par ja sakein ge.
warmup: Aap ki university do terms ke students ke marks rakhti hai. Ek term ke liye aap table bana sakte hain: har student ki ek row, har subject ka ek column. Yeh 2-D table hai. Ab doosre term ka table pehle table ke peeche rakh dein, copy ke pages ki tarah. Ek mark dhoondne ke liye aap ko teen cheezein chahiye: kaun sa term (page), kaun sa student (row), kaun sa subject (column). 3-D array bilkul aise tables ka ek stack hai.
definition: 3-D array woh array hai jis ka har element ek 2-D array hota hai. Isay teen sizes ke saath declare kiya jata hai: type name[layers][rows][columns];. Misaal ke taur par int a[2][3][4]; mein 2 layers hain, har layer mein 3 rows hain, aur har row mein 4 columns hain. Elements ki total tadaad teeno sizes ka product hoti hai: 2 x 3 x 4 = 24. Kisi element tak teen indexes se pohanchte hain, usi tarteeb mein: a[layer][row][column]. Har index 0 se shuru hota hai.
howItWorks: Memory mein koi 3-D model nahi hota jise dekha ja sake. Layers ko pages ki tarah socho: pehla index page chunta hai, doosra index us page ki row chunta hai, aur teesra column chunta hai. Computer asal mein saare elements ko ek lambi line mein store karta hai, layer ke baad layer, row ke baad row (flattened array wala visual dekhein). Initialisation ke liye nested braces use karein: poore array ke liye ek jori, har layer ke liye ek jori, har row ke liye ek jori. Har element par jane ke liye teen nested loops use karein, har index ke liye ek. Bahar wala loop layer hai, beech wala loop row hai, andar wala loop column hai. Loop ki limits wohi teen sizes honi chahiyen jis tarteeb se declaration mein hain, aur har loop < use karta hai (kabhi <= nahi), kyunke aakhri valid index size - 1 hota hai. Total elements = layers x rows x columns, is liye int a[2][3][4] mein 24 values hoti hain aur sab se andar wala statement 24 dafa chalta hai.
